body: Fixes #1914. `--isolation docker` had two distinct, independently-broken behaviors on the Docker-in-Docker bot host. Both are fixed here, in all the places they occur, and backed by a deep case study + regression tests. ## Complaint 1 — it wasn't real Docker isolation `$ --status` reported `options / isolated screen` because Hive Mind launched isolated tasks as **`$ --isolated screen -- docker run …`** — a `screen` wrapper around a raw `docker run`, not start-command's native Docker backend. **Root cause:** the command Hive Mind handed to start-command. `src/isolation-runner.lib.mjs` now builds the native form (`buildDockerIsolationStartArgs`): ``` $ --isolated docker --image [--privileged] --shell sh \ -e HOME=/home/box -e HIVE_MIND_PARENT_SESSION_ID= -e HIVE_MIND_IMAGE_VARIANT= \ --volume … --detached --session -- '' ``` so start-command owns the container lifecycle and `--status` now reports real Docker isolation. Liveness checks follow the backend too: native docker uses `docker inspect` on the `--session`-named container (`checkDockerContainerRunning`), not `screen -ls`. ## Complaint 2 — the 30+ GB image was re-downloaded for every task The bot runs inside a DinD container whose **nested `dockerd` starts with an empty image store**. box can seed it from the host (host-image passthrough), but **only when the host Docker socket is bind-mounted** — and when it isn't, passthrough is a **silent no-op**, so the first isolated task pulls the whole multi-GB image from the registry. #1860 / #1879 didn't fix this because they addressed reuse semantics, not the empty nested daemon. **Real production root cause:** the deploy script's final `docker run` never mounted the host socket and never set the passthrough allowlist. Fixed in the deploy gist (revision 5) — the dind variant now passes `-v /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/host-docker.sock:ro` + `-e DIND_HOST_PASSTHROUGH_IMAGES="konard/hive-mind konard/hive-mind-dind"`. The token-free patch is archived at [`docs/case-studies/issue-1914/data/deploy-docker.passthrough-fix.patch`](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/blob/issue-1914-8a8c25b9f161/docs/case-studies/issue-1914/data/deploy-docker.passthrough-fix.patch). **In-repo safety net:** a startup preflight (`preflightDockerIsolation`, wired into `src/telegram-bot.mjs`) probes the nested daemon at boot and, when the image is absent, prints the exact remediation for each state instead of letting an operator discover it as a surprise mid-task download — directly answering the issue's ask for "debug output and verbose mode … that will allow us to find root cause on next iteration": | State | Preflight output | |---|---| | image present | `✅ … already present locally — isolated tasks reuse it (no multi-GB pull)` | | dind + socket **not** mounted | ⚠️ mount `/var/run/docker.sock:…:ro` + set `DIND_HOST_PASSTHROUGH_IMAGES`, or run the preload script | | dind + socket mounted | ⚠️ passthrough may have skipped — check `DIND_HOST_PASSTHROUGH` mode / allowlist / host digest | | non-dind | ⚠️ first task will pull; pin `HIVE_MIND_DOCKER_ISOLATION_IMAGE_TAG` or preload | ## Upstream Filed **link-foundation/box#102**: when an operator opts in via `DIND_HOST_PASSTHROUGH_IMAGES` but no host socket is mounted, box should `warn` instead of silently doing nothing (it already warns on a *present-but-unreachable* socket). Includes a reproducible example and a one-`warn` code suggestion. start-command needs no change — its reuse-if-present behavior (`docker image inspect` before pull) is correct. ## Case study [`docs/case-studies/issue-1914/`](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/blob/issue-1914-8a8c25b9f161/docs/case-studies/issue-1914/README.md) reconstructs the timeline (#1545 → #1860 → #1879 → #1914), enumerates every requirement from the issue and where it's addressed, documents both root causes with quoted evidence (`$ --status`, manual `docker pull` reproduction), surveys existing components considered, and records the operator runbook + deploy fix. Raw evidence (issue/PR JSON, session logs, box#102, the deploy mirror + patch) is under `data/`. ## How to reproduce (Complaint 2) ```bash # Host already has the image we want reused inside the nested daemon: docker pull hello-world # Passthrough ENABLED + allowlist set, but host socket NOT mounted (the bug): docker run --rm --privileged \ -e DIND_HOST_PASSTHROUGH=public -e DIND_HOST_PASSTHROUGH_IMAGES="hello-world" \ konard/box-dind:latest bash -lc 'docker run --rm hello-world' # Observed: nested daemon PULLS hello-world; no warning that passthrough was skipped. # With -v /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/host-docker.sock:ro added → reuse, no pull. ``` ## Tests All four files are tagged into the `default` suite and pass locally (clean env), plus full `npm test` green: - `tests/test-issue-1914-native-docker-isolation.mjs` (20) — native `$ --isolated docker` command shape (image/privileged/shell/session/`--`), `docker inspect` liveness (not `screen -ls`). - `tests/test-issue-1914-preflight-passthrough.mjs` (32) — the four preflight states above + `resolveHostDockerSock` (honors `DIND_HOST_DOCKER_SOCK`) + `checkDockerImagePresent` never throws. - `tests/test-issue-1860-docker-isolation.mjs` (33) — Complaint-1 native shape across the queued/tracked paths. - `tests/test-issue-1879-docker-image-reuse.mjs` (12) — no `--pull` flag is injected; reuse-if-present is inherent. ## Before / after | | Before | After | |---|---|---| | `--status` backend | `isolated screen` (wrapping `docker run …`) | native `isolated docker` | | nested daemon seeding | silent no-op → 30+ GB pull on first task | host-socket passthrough in deploy + loud startup preflight | | diagnosability | none (surprise mid-task download) | boot-time `✅`/`⚠️` with exact remediation; `[VERBOSE]` backend trace | ## box dependency bump — box#102 fixed upstream The upstream footgun filed as [link-foundation/box#102](https://github.com/link-foundation/box/issues/102) (passthrough silent no-op when an allowlist is set but no host socket is mounted) is **fixed and shipped in [box v2.3.2](https://github.com/link-foundation/box/releases/tag/v2.3.2)** — the dind entrypoint now `warn`s instead of staying silent. This repo's base images are bumped `2.3.1 → 2.3.2` everywhere (`Dockerfile`, `Dockerfile.dind`, `coolify/Dockerfile`, the `UBUNTU-SERVER` docs, and the asserting tests), so the warning ships at the source — the in-repo preflight remains as a complementary safety net. ## Note for maintainers (pre-existing, not introduced here) The deploy gist's **other** file, `deploy-remote-docker.mjs`, contains a `TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN` in its `.lenv.example` template. Per maintainer confirmation this token was **revoked long ago and is only an example value**, so no action is needed (the earlier rotation recommendation is withdrawn). This PR did **not** touch that file and the token is **not** reproduced anywhere in this repo. > Per the release process, the version is intentionally **not** bumped in `package.json` (`scripts/check-version.mjs` prohibits manual bumps); CI bumps it from the changeset on merge.

Adding .gitkeep for PR creation (default mode).
This file will be removed when the task is complete.

Issue: https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/issues/1914

… passthrough

Complaint 2 of issue #1914: the bot runs inside a DinD container whose nested
Docker daemon starts empty, so the first `--isolation docker` task re-pulls the
multi-GB Hive Mind image even though the host already has it. box can seed the
nested daemon (host-image passthrough), but only when the host Docker socket is
bind-mounted into the container — without it, passthrough is a SILENT no-op.

- isolation-runner.lib.mjs: add resolveHostDockerSock() (honors box's
  DIND_HOST_DOCKER_SOCK), checkDockerImagePresent(), and preflightDockerIsolation()
  that probes the nested daemon at startup and warns loudly with exact remediation
  (mount the socket + set DIND_HOST_PASSTHROUGH_IMAGES, or run the preload script).
- telegram-bot.mjs: run the preflight on startup when --isolation docker is set
  (never throws, never blocks startup).
- preload-dind-isolation-image.mjs: drop the obsolete HIVE_MIND_DOCKER_ISOLATION_PULL
  tip; point operators at automatic passthrough (socket mount) instead.
- docs/DOCKER.md (+ zh/hi/ru): new 'Host-image passthrough' section documenting
  the socket mount, passthrough env vars, the startup preflight, and the manual
  fallback.
- tests: add test-issue-1914-preflight-passthrough.mjs (32 assertions across the
  four startup states); refresh the #1860/#1879/#1914 native-shape tests.

Refs #1914 #1879

- Reconstructs the timeline across #1545/#1860/#1879/#1914.
- Lists every requirement from the issue and where it is addressed.
- Root-causes both complaints: Complaint 1 (Hive Mind built a screen

  backend) and Complaint 2 (the production deploy never mounts the host
  Docker socket, so box host-image passthrough is a silent no-op and the
  nested daemon stays empty -> first task re-pulls the multi-GB image).

  (only pulls when 'docker image inspect' fails), box passthrough env
  vars, and deploy-docker.mjs line 342 missing the socket mount.

  and records the upstream report plan for link-foundation/box.

mounted. The real gap — and the production root cause of #1914 — is that
box stays silent even when the operator has clearly opted in via
DIND_HOST_PASSTHROUGH_IMAGES but forgot the socket mount.

and a minimal one-warn code suggestion. Updated the case study's Upstream
Report to cite #102 and reflect box's precise behavior; saved the issue
JSON under data/.
